town_description: Mokokchung is the district headquarters of Mokokchung district in Nagaland, set at about 1,325 m altitude, and is known as the cultural and intellectual capital of the state. It is the homeland of the Ao Naga tribe, who introduced Christianity to the region in the 19th century; around 95% of the district's population is Baptist Christian. The main Ao festivals are Moatsu (sowing, early May) and Tsungremmong (harvest, August).
